statement.p: Consider each of the following scenarios/processes. Identify each one as an atomic process, a near-atomic process, or neither. As a reminder, atomic processes cannot be decomposed into smaller, sub-processes and a near-atomic process is a process where only one action is ultimately taken out of a slate of possible actions (each of which is an atomic process on its own).

ol.li:
Choosing a cupcake, cookie, or brownie from a bakery that sells multiple flavors of each.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither

Choosing a donut and a beverage to order from a cafe menu.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither

Drawing a random card from a set of 10 cards or rolling a fair, six-sided die.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither

Drawing a name from a hat filled with slips of paper with names written on them.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither

Rolling a red die and a blue die.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither

Rolling a red die or a blue die.
Atomic
Near-Atomic
Neither
